source: Horiba press release: HORIBA Launches the EMIA-20XC Carbon Analyzer for (10-07-2026)

players.product: mass flow controllers and in-situ process monitors for semiconductor tools

quarterly_data.signal: Horiba launched the EMIA-20XC, a new carbon and sulfur analyzer in its EMIA-Expert series designed for high-carbon materials such as tungsten carbide used in cemented carbide. Horiba states that under specified conditions it achieves a relative standard deviation of 0.15% or less in repeated measurements of a tungsten carbide reference sample, and that it covers 0.6 ppm to 20.0% carbon and 0.6 ppm to 1.0% sulfur depending on operating mode and sample mass.
quarterly_data.figure: RSD 0.15% or less; carbon range 0.6 ppm to 20.0%
